title: Cancel-at-period-end toggles are ignored unless the payload also carries a status; Account never says "won't renew"
persona: Trial user, day 7 (QA-PAYWALL, signed webhooks + forged sl_session cookie)
steps: uid qa_tri_2: activated trialing, then membership.updated {cancel_at_period_end:true} with no status -> {"ignored":"membership.updated"}
Open /account: "Free trial · ends Nov 22" with no "won't renew"
With status:"trialing" in the same payload it works ("· won't renew") (qa_tri_4)
expected: Account says it will not renew after the user cancels during the trial.
actual: Event ignored, cancel flag never stored; user thinks they are still going to be charged (or isn't told it will end). Depends on whether real Whop payloads carry status on these events (guess: the cancel_at_period_end_changed event name suggests it may not).
suspected_area: membership.ts statusFromWebhook returns null for update/cancel-toggle events; route.ts returns before upsert
